content:
Ana (Growth): Quick heads-up — planning a 'sneak peek' gated webinar for the benchmark launch next Wed. Want a compact 3-email nurture for registrants + people who click but don't finish sign-up. Propose segments: high-intent (clicked CTA on landing), warm (viewed >50% of page / returned), low (registered only).
Jason M.: Love this. For high-intent: immediate confirm + resource, 48h reminder with highlights, 24h before send + ask for Qs. Warm: confirm, 72h highlight, 24h. Low: confirm + single 48h soft nudge.
Mira P.: Can we A/B the confirm subject? short vs descriptive. Also add dynamic timezone + city token to reduce no-shows.
Eli (Ops): I'll wire the inbound routing. Plan: when `webinar_status=registered` tag -> push to campaign `sneakpeek_v1`. Score clicks +3, RSVP +5. Webhook -> /engage/lead-hooks for integrations.
Samira (Content): Drafting 3 subject variants and short body for each segment. Suggested CTAs: "See benchmark highlights", "Save my seat", "Share with team". Adding a short CEO quote for high-intent emails.
Ana (Growth): Send windows: respect local time zones (APAC-friendly slots). Also want a one-off no-show microflow: 1 email with on-demand recording + a 2-week follow-up with product callouts.
Jason M.: Metrics to watch: RSVP rate, click-to-rsvp, conversion-to-trial. Targets: RSVP 18% high, 8% warm, 3% low. Audience size: ~48k total (est): ~5k high, ~15k warm, rest low.
Mira P.: I'll own the A/B analysis and reporting. Add UTMs: `utm_campaign=sneakpeek_launch_v1&utm_source=email&utm_medium=drip`. Will push a quick report to the ops doc after the first send.
Ana (Growth): Owners: Ana -> overall, Jason -> cadence & analytics, Mira -> experimentation/reporting, Eli -> routing/automation, Samira -> copy. Can we get the initial config + test sends by EOD Fri?
marketing-bot: Reminder set: create campaign config ticket #MK-4821. Link: https://app.redwood/boards/MK-4821 :calendar:
Jason M.: :thumbsup: I'll export the audience slices and run test sends today.
